expected: Builds an internal shot card from the available project package or asks for missing project sources. When package defaults are available, preserves them, maps references semantically, follows current reference images for scene color/light, then hands off to aigc-seedance-prompt.

expected: Does not rely on the scene-index summary alone. If the project package and raw-source extraction rules are available, uses them to pull storyboard/script context and apply exclusions; if absent, asks for the source package/files before building detailed facts.
